**NOTES FOR SELF AND INSTRUCTIONS**

* the data files you want to process must be in .xlsx format in the project folder; these must be the only .xlsx files present in the folder (or you need to change the code)
* processing more than one file only makes sense if they are all from the same experiment and a common report is needed; the files should also have the same structure and a coherent system for naming of blanks and treatments  
* when processing more than one file and in any case there are biological replicates, the replicate/file number must be included in the name of the strain (and may be split later)


```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# NOTES FOR SELF
# in the future I might want to use nlsTools

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# loading packages
.cran_packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "nlsMicrobio","crayon", 
                    "broom", "kableExtra", "ggtext")

.inst <- .cran_packages %in% installed.packages()
if(any(!.inst)) {
  install.packages(.cran_packages[!.inst])
}

       character.only = TRUE)

opar <- par(no.readonly=TRUE) 
par(ask=F) 
set.seed(1234) 
# options for saving
save_graph <- T
save_data <- T
# output folder
out_folder <- "gc_output"
if((save_graph | save_data) & !dir.exists("gc_output")) dir.create("gc_output")
fn_prefix <- "testing_gc_script"

```
# Introduction.  

This script uses a parametric approach to model growth curves of microorganisms obtained from Varioskan microplate reader using the SkanIt software. The script can use the reports from multiple kinetic runs, and performs (in a semi-automated fashion) the following stept:

1. import the data  

2. do rough plots

3. perform basic filtering   

4. use a combination of dplyr and broom with nls to perform non-linear regression using parametric models (here variations of the [Baranyi and Roberts D-model](https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/0168-1605(94)90157-0); the best model is selected on the basis of the AIC)  

5. plot the results and the fit  

6. perform secondary modelling

Two notable alternatives to this approach would be:

1. QurvE: an [on-line tool](https://www.qurveanalysis.com/app/qurve) for analyzing growth curves  

2. gcplyr: a [R package](https://github.com/mikeblazanin/gcplyr) which performs parametric and non parametric analysis of growth curves

# Part 1. 

## Importing the data.  

The data must be reports exported from SkanIt kinetics module, in .xlsx format.

```{r import_xlsx, warning = F, message = F}

# find .xlsx files in the working directory
file_list <- list.files()
xlsx_files <- file_list[str_detect(file_list, "xlsx$") & !str_detect(file_list, "^~")]
xlsx_files <- purrr::set_names(xlsx_files)
# create a tibble for blank replacement
blank_replacements <- tribble(
  ~old, ~new,
  "Blank1", "Blank_0",
  "Blank2", "Blank_15",
  "Blank3", "Blank_3",
  "Blank4", "Blank_45",
  "Blank5", "Blank_6",
  "Blank6", "Blank_9"
)
# NOTE FOR SELF: I should remove those which begin with a tilde
if(length(xlsx_files) == 1){
  raw_gc_data <- read_xlsx(xlsx_files, skip = 9)
  # remove the extra content
  # which is na
  last_row <- which(is.na(raw_gc_data[,1]))[1]-1
  raw_gc_data <- slice(raw_gc_data, 1:last_row) |>
    mutate(Reading = as.numeric(Reading)) |>
    select(where(is.numeric))
  # fix names
  col_names_old <- colnames(raw_gc_data)
  col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_old, "\\(|\\)", "")
  col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_new, "\\[|\\]", "")
  col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_new, "\\.", "")
  col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_new, " ", "_")
  # replace
  colnames(raw_gc_data) <- col_names_new
  # rename blanks
  for(i in 1:nrow(blank_replacements)){
    colnames(raw_gc_data) <- str_replace(colnames(raw_gc_data), 
                                         blank_replacements$old[i],
                                         blank_replacements$new[i])
  }
} else {
  raw_gc_data_list <- map(xlsx_files, \(x) read_xlsx(x, skip = 9))
  # process the individual files
  for(i in seq_along(raw_gc_data_list)){
    last_row_i <- which(is.na(raw_gc_data_list[[i]][,1]))[1]-1
    raw_gc_data_list[[i]] <- slice(raw_gc_data_list[[i]], 1:last_row_i) |>
      mutate(Reading = as.numeric(Reading)) |>
      select(where(is.numeric))
    col_names_old <- colnames(raw_gc_data_list[[i]])
    col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_old, "\\(|\\)", "")
    col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_new, "\\[|\\]", "")
    col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_new, "\\.", "")
    col_names_new <- str_replace_all(col_names_new, " ", "_")
    # replace
    colnames(raw_gc_data_list[[i]]) <- col_names_new 
    # rename blanks
    for(j in 1:nrow(blank_replacements)){
      colnames(raw_gc_data_list[[i]]) <- str_replace(colnames(raw_gc_data_list[[i]]), 
                                                     blank_replacements$old[j],
                                                     blank_replacements$new[j])
    }
  }
}

```

## A very rough plot (no blank subtraction, no assumptions).  

This is a very fast and dirty plot, carried out by averaging readings and showing them with lowess smoothing in a grid plot.  

```{r rough_plot}
if(length(xlsx_files) == 1){
  raw_gc_data_means <- raw_gc_data |>
    pivot_longer(3:ncol(raw_gc_data), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "OD600") |>
    separate_wider_delim("treatment", "_", 
                         names = c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "well")) |>
    arrange(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc) |>
    summarise(mean_OD = mean(OD600, na.rm = T),
              sd_OD = sd(OD600, na.rm = T), 
              .by = c(Reading, avg_time_s, strain, NaCl_conc)) |>
    mutate(NaCl_conc = str_replace(NaCl_conc, "5", ".5")) |>
    mutate(NaCl_conc = as.numeric(NaCl_conc))
  # this is to visualize raw growth curves
  raw_gc_data_means <- raw_gc_data_means  |>
    mutate(time_h = avg_time_s/3600)
  
  raw_gc_data_means |>
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = time_h, y = log10(mean_OD), 
                         color = factor(NaCl_conc))) +
    facet_wrap(~strain) +
    geom_smooth() +
    labs(x = "time, h",
         y = "log(OD600)",
         color = "NaCl % w/v") +
    theme_bw()
} else {
  raw_gc_data_means_list <- vector(mode = "list", 
                                   length = length(raw_gc_data_list))
  raw_gc_data_plots_list <- vector(mode = "list", 
                                   length = length(raw_gc_data_list))
  for(i in seq_along(raw_gc_data_list)){
    raw_gc_data_means_list[[i]] <- raw_gc_data_list[[i]] 
    raw_gc_data_means_list[[i]] <- raw_gc_data_means_list[[i]] |>
      pivot_longer(3:ncol(raw_gc_data_means_list[[i]]), 
                   names_to = "treatment", values_to = "OD600") |>
      separate_wider_delim("treatment", "_", 
                           names = c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "well")) |>
      arrange(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc) |>
      summarise(mean_OD = mean(OD600, na.rm = T),
                sd_OD = sd(OD600, na.rm = T), 
                .by = c(Reading, avg_time_s, strain, NaCl_conc)) |>
      mutate(NaCl_conc = str_replace(NaCl_conc, "5", ".5")) |>
      mutate(NaCl_conc = as.numeric(NaCl_conc))
    
    raw_gc_data_means_list[[i]] <- raw_gc_data_means_list[[i]]  |>
      mutate(time_h = avg_time_s/3600)
    
    names(raw_gc_data_means_list)[i] <- names(raw_gc_data_list)[i]
    # now the plot
    plot_title <- names(raw_gc_data_means_list)[i]
    raw_gc_data_plots_list[[i]] <- raw_gc_data_means_list[[i]] |>
      ggplot(mapping = aes(x = time_h, y = log10(mean_OD), 
                           color = factor(NaCl_conc))) +
      facet_wrap(~strain) +
      geom_smooth() +
      labs(title = plot_title,
           x = "time, h",
           y = "log(OD600)",
           color = "NaCl % w/v") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    names(raw_gc_data_plots_list)[i] <- names(raw_gc_data_list)[i]
    print(raw_gc_data_plots_list[[i]])
  }
}
```
There is a problem with two blanks (0 and 1.5% NaCl for one experiment 270325) for which some growth after 14 h of incubation was obseerved. This will be filtered out.  

```{r ad_hoc_filter}
run_ad_hoc <- T
if(run_ad_hoc){
  slot_to_filter <- which(names(raw_gc_data_list) == "EspNaCl_2_270325.xlsx")
  gc_to_filter <- raw_gc_data_list[[slot_to_filter]]
  cols_to_mutate <- names(gc_to_filter)[str_detect(names(gc_to_filter), "_0_|_15_")]
  time_stop <- 3600*14 
  gc_to_filter <- gc_to_filter %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_mutate), ~ if_else(avg_time_s>=time_stop, NA_real_, .x)))
  raw_gc_data_list[[slot_to_filter]] <- gc_to_filter
}

```


## Plotting with blank subtraction.  

This section prints a plot with blank absorbance removed.  

```{r plot_blanked, message = F}

if(length(xlsx_files) == 1){
  # get averages for blank values
  blank_data <- raw_gc_data |>
    select(contains("Reading") | contains("Blank"))
  blank_data <- blank_data |>
    pivot_longer(2:ncol(blank_data), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "OD600") |>
    separate_wider_delim("treatment", "_", names = c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "well")) |>
    arrange(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc) |>
    summarise(mean_B_OD = mean(OD600, na.rm = T), 
              .by = c(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc))
  # pivot the data
  sample_data <- raw_gc_data |>
    select(!contains("Blank")) 
  sample_data <- sample_data |>
    pivot_longer(3:ncol(sample_data), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "OD600") |>
    separate_wider_delim("treatment", "_", 
                         names = c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "well"),
                         cols_remove = F) |>
    arrange(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc)
  # join blanks
  sample_data_w_mean_blank <- left_join(
    sample_data, select(blank_data, Reading, NaCl_conc, mean_B_OD)
  ) |>
    mutate(time_h = avg_time_s/3600) |>
    mutate(NaCl_conc = str_replace(NaCl_conc, "5", ".5")) |>
    mutate(NaCl_conc = as.numeric(NaCl_conc))
  # substract blank
  sample_data_w_mean_blank <- sample_data_w_mean_blank |>
    mutate(OD600_b = if_else((OD600 - mean_B_OD)>0, (OD600 - mean_B_OD), 0))
  # extract blanked values at time 0 for each strain
  time_0_blanked <- sample_data_w_mean_blank |>
    dplyr::filter(Reading == 1) |>
    mutate(OD600_b = if_else(OD600_b>0, OD600_b, 0.0001)) |>
    select(treatment, OD600_b0 = OD600_b)
  # join 
  sample_data_w_mean_blank <- sample_data_w_mean_blank |>
    left_join(time_0_blanked) 
  sample_data_w_mean_blank <- sample_data_w_mean_blank |>
    mutate(lnODOD0 = log(OD600_b/OD600_b0)) |>
    arrange(well, Reading)
  # try with means
  sample_data_stats <- sample_data_w_mean_blank |>
    select(Reading, time_h, strain, NaCl_conc, OD600, OD600_b, OD600_b0) |>
    dplyr::filter(OD600>0 & OD600_b>0 & OD600_b0>0) |>
    summarize(mean_lnOD = mean(log(OD600), na.rm = T),
              sd_lnOD = sd(log(OD600), na.rm = T),
              mean_lnODb = mean(log(OD600_b), na.rm = T),
              sd_lnODb = sd(log(OD600_b), na.rm = T),
              mean_lnODb0 = mean(log(OD600_b0), na.rm = T),
              sd_lnODb0 = sd(log(OD600_b0), na.rm = T),
              .by = c(Reading, time_h, strain, NaCl_conc,)
    ) |>
    mutate(mean_lnODOD0 = mean_lnODb-mean_lnODb0)
  sample_data_stats |>
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = time_h, y = mean_lnODb, 
                         color = factor(NaCl_conc))) +
    facet_wrap(~strain) +
    geom_smooth(se = F) +
    labs(x = "time, h",
         y = "ln(OD)",
         color = "NaCl % w/v")
} else {
  # create list for original data and stats
  sample_data_list <- vector(mode = "list", 
                                   length = length(raw_gc_data_list))
  sample_data_stats_list <- vector(mode = "list", 
                                   length = length(raw_gc_data_list))
  names(sample_data_list) <- names(sample_data_stats_list) <- names(raw_gc_data_list)
  # handle calculation in a loop
  for(i in seq_along(raw_gc_data_list)){
    blank_data_i <- raw_gc_data_list[[i]] |>
      select(contains("Reading") | contains("Blank")) 
    blank_data_i <- blank_data_i |>
      pivot_longer(2:ncol(blank_data_i), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "OD600") |>
      separate_wider_delim("treatment", "_", names = c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "well")) |>
      arrange(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc) |>
      summarise(mean_B_OD = mean(OD600, na.rm = T), 
                .by = c(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc))
    # pivot the data
    sample_data_i <- raw_gc_data_list[[i]] |>
      select(!contains("Blank")) 
    sample_data_i <- sample_data_i |>
      pivot_longer(3:ncol(sample_data_i), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "OD600") |>
      separate_wider_delim("treatment", "_", 
                           names = c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "well"),
                           cols_remove = F) |>
      arrange(Reading, strain, NaCl_conc)
    sample_data_list[[i]] <- left_join(
      sample_data_i, select(blank_data_i, Reading, NaCl_conc, mean_B_OD)
    ) |>
      mutate(time_h = avg_time_s/3600) |>
      mutate(NaCl_conc = str_replace(NaCl_conc, "5", ".5")) |>
      mutate(NaCl_conc = as.numeric(NaCl_conc))
    # substract blank
    sample_data_list[[i]] <- sample_data_list[[i]] |>
      mutate(OD600_b = if_else((OD600 - mean_B_OD)>0, (OD600 - mean_B_OD), 0))
    # extract blanked values at time 0 for each strain
    time_0_blanked_i <- sample_data_list[[i]] |>
      dplyr::filter(Reading == 1) |>
      mutate(OD600_b = if_else(OD600_b>0, OD600_b, 0.0001)) |>
      select(treatment, OD600_b0 = OD600_b)
    # join 
    sample_data_list[[i]] <- sample_data_list[[i]] |>
      left_join(time_0_blanked_i) 
    sample_data_list[[i]] <- sample_data_list[[i]] |>
      mutate(lnODOD0 = log(OD600_b/OD600_b0)) |>
      arrange(well, Reading)
    
    # try with means
  sample_data_stats_list[[i]] <- sample_data_list[[i]] |>
    select(Reading, time_h, strain, NaCl_conc, OD600, OD600_b, OD600_b0) |>
    dplyr::filter(OD600>0 & OD600_b>0 & OD600_b0>0) |>
    summarize(mean_lnOD = mean(log(OD600), na.rm = T),
              sd_lnOD = sd(log(OD600), na.rm = T),
              mean_lnODb = mean(log(OD600_b), na.rm = T),
              sd_lnODb = sd(log(OD600_b), na.rm = T),
              mean_lnODb0 = mean(log(OD600_b0), na.rm = T),
              sd_lnODb0 = sd(log(OD600_b0), na.rm = T),
              .by = c(Reading, time_h, strain, NaCl_conc,)
    ) |>
    mutate(mean_lnODOD0 = mean_lnODb-mean_lnODb0)
  
  plot_title <- names(sample_data_list)[[i]]
  mean_plot_i <- sample_data_stats_list[[i]] |>
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = time_h, y = mean_lnODb, 
                         color = factor(NaCl_conc))) +
    facet_wrap(~strain) +
    geom_smooth(se = F) +
    labs(title = plot_title,
         x = "time, h",
         y = "ln(OD)",
         color = "NaCl % w/v") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  print(mean_plot_i)
  names(sample_data_list)[i] <- names(raw_gc_data_list)[i]
  names(sample_data_stats_list)[i] <- names(raw_gc_data_list)[i]
  }
  rm(blank_data_i, sample_data_i, time_0_blanked_i, mean_plot_i)
}

```

# Part 2. Fitting primary and secondary models.  

## Calculate growth curve parameters.  

The approach is based on the creation of a long format tibble, which is then nested based on the combination of factors (strain, NaCl and, in the case of multiple files or replicates, day) and used for estimation of growth curve parameters using a custom function.

```{r nls_modelling, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error=F}
# prepare for fitting
if(length(xlsx_files) == 1){
  gc <- select(sample_data_stats, t = time_h, strain, NaCl_conc, 
               mean_lnODb, sd_lnODb, mean_lnODb0, sd_lnODb0)
} else {
  # these is needed to handle replicate growth curves in different days
  gc <- sample_data_stats_list |>
    list_rbind(names_to = "file") |>
    select(t = time_h, strain, NaCl_conc, 
           mean_lnODb, sd_lnODb, mean_lnODb0, sd_lnODb0, file) |>
    mutate(file = as.factor(file),
           strain_code = strain) |>
    mutate(exp = as.numeric(file)) |>
    mutate(strain = str_c(strain,exp, sep = "_"))
}

# calculate summaries, needed for starting parameters
gc_summaries <- gc |>
  summarise(min_y = min(mean_lnODb),
            max_y = max(mean_lnODb),
            .by = c(strain, NaCl_conc))

# create a nested df to be handled by purrr and broom functions
nested_gc <- gc |>
  select(t, strain, NaCl_conc, LOG10N = mean_lnODb) |>
  nest(growth_curve = c(-strain, -NaCl_conc))

# join the starting values
nested_gc <- left_join(nested_gc, gc_summaries)

# create a list with the models and starting values to be used (the latter as a logical)
model_list <- list(
  nls_models = list(b = baranyi, 
                    bwl = baranyi_without_lag, 
                    bwN = baranyi_without_Nmax),
  geom_smooth_models = list(
    b_gs = y ~ LOG10Nmax + log10((-1 + exp(mumax * lag) + exp(mumax * 
    x))/(exp(mumax * x) - 1 + exp(mumax * lag) * 10^(LOG10Nmax - 
    LOG10N0))),
    bwl_gs = y ~ (LOG10Nmax - log10(1 + (10^(LOG10Nmax - LOG10N0) - 1) * 
    exp(-mumax * x))),
    bwN_gs = y ~ LOG10N0 + mumax * x/log(10) + log10(exp(-mumax * x) * 
    (1 - exp(-mumax * lag)) + exp(-mumax * lag))
  ),
  parameter_indices = list(
    b_p = c(mumax = T, lag = T, LOG10N0 = T, LOG10Nmax = T),
    bwl_p = c(mumax = T, lag = F, LOG10N0 = T, LOG10Nmax = T),
    bwN_p = c(mumax = T, lag = T, LOG10N0 = T, LOG10Nmax = F)
  )
  )

# a function for extracting the best fitting model, if any
extract_best_fit <- function(d, m = model_list$nls_models, 
                             p = model_list$parameter_indices, mn, mx){ 
  all_parameters <- list(mumax=1,
                         lag=1, 
                         LOG10N0 = mn, 
                         LOG10Nmax = mx)
  nls_fit <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(m))
  for(i in seq_along(m)){
    nls_fit[[i]] <- try(nls(formula = m[[i]], data = d, start = all_parameters[p[[i]]]))
    names(nls_fit)[i] <- names(m)[i]
  }
  rm(i)
  nls_fit <- nls_fit[str_detect(map_chr(nls_fit, class),"nls")]
  # a default return value
  glance_df <- NULL
  tidy_df <- NULL
  if(any(str_detect(map_chr(nls_fit, class),"nls"))){
    glance_df <- map(nls_fit, glance) |>
      list_rbind(names_to = "model") |>
      arrange(AIC)
    best_model <- glance_df$model[1]
    glance_df <- glance_df[1,]
    # tidy and select the best model
    tidy_df <- map(nls_fit, \(x) try(tidy(x, conf.int = F, conf.level = 0.95))) |>
      list_rbind(names_to = "model") |>
      dplyr::filter(model == best_model)
    best_fit <- nls_fit[which(names(nls_fit) == best_model)]
  }
  return(tdg  <- list(
              fit = nls_fit,
              best_fit = best_fit,
              tidied = tidy_df,
              glanced = glance_df
              ))
}
# used for testing
try_me <- F
if(try_me){
  gc1 <- nested_gc[14,] |> unnest(c(growth_curve))
  
  prova <- extract_best_fit(
    d = select(gc1, t, LOG10N),
    m = model_list$nls_models, 
    p = model_list$parameter_indices,
    mn = min(gc1$LOG10N),
    mx = max(gc1$LOG10N)
  )
  }

# data to process

nls_model_list <-  pmap(.l = select(nested_gc, growth_curve, min_y, max_y),
       .f = try(function(growth_curve, min_y, max_y){
         gc <- growth_curve
         mny <- min_y
         mxy <- max_y
         tdgl <- extract_best_fit(gc, m = model_list$nls_models, 
                          p = model_list$parameter_indices, 
                          mny, mxy)
         return(tdgl$best_fit)
         })
       )

nested_gc <- nested_gc |>
  mutate(fits = map(nls_model_list, \(x) pluck(x,1)),
         best_model = map_chr(nls_model_list, names)) |>
  mutate(tidied = map(fits, tidy),
         glanced = map(fits, glance),
         augmented = map(fits, augment))
# a data frame of model parameters
v1 <- c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "best_model", "term", "estimate", "std.error", 
    "statistic", "p.value")
v2 <- c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "exp" ,"best_model", "term", "estimate", "std.error", 
    "statistic", "p.value")
fitted_values <- nested_gc |>
  dplyr::filter(map(nested_gc$tidied, is.data.frame) |> unlist()) |>
  unnest(cols = c(tidied))
if(length(xlsx_files) == 1){
  fitted_values <- select(fitted_values, any_of(v1))
} else {
  fitted_values <- select(fitted_values, any_of(v2))
}
# a data frame of glanced stats
v1 <- c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "best_model", "sigma", "isConv", "finTol", 
    "logLik", "AIC", "BIC", "deviance", "df.residual", "nobs")
v2 <- c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "exp", "best_model", "sigma", "isConv", "finTol", 
    "logLik", "AIC", "BIC", "deviance", "df.residual", "nobs")
glanced_values <- nested_gc |>
  dplyr::filter(map(nested_gc$glanced, is.data.frame) |> unlist()) |>
  unnest(cols = c(glanced))
if(length(xlsx_files) == 1){
  glanced_values <- select(glanced_values, any_of(v1))
} else {
  glanced_values <- select(glanced_values, any_of(v2))
}

# a data frame of augmented values
v1 <- c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "t", "LOG10N", ".fitted", ".resid")
v2 <- c("strain", "NaCl_conc", "exp", "t","LOG10N", ".fitted", ".resid")
augmented_values <- nested_gc |>
  dplyr::filter(map(nested_gc$augmented, is.data.frame) |> unlist()) |>
  unnest(cols = c(augmented))
if(length(xlsx_files) == 1){
  augmented_values <- select(augmented_values, any_of(v1))
} else {
  augmented_values <- select(augmented_values, any_of(v2))
}
augmented_values <- left_join(
  gc,
  select(augmented_values, strain, NaCl_conc, t, fitted =`.fitted`)
)

# save data
if(save_data){
  write_tsv(fitted_values, 
            file.path(out_folder, file = str_c(fn_prefix,"_fittedgcdata.txt")))
  write_tsv(glanced_values, 
            file.path(out_folder, file = str_c(fn_prefix,"_goodnesoffit.txt")))
  write_tsv(augmented_values, 
            file.path(out_folder, file = str_c(fn_prefix,"_predictedvalues.txt")))
}
```

The following graph shows the fitted growth curves.  

```{r fitted_growth_curves, warning = F, message = F}
fitted_curves <- augmented_values |>
  ggplot(aes(x=t, color = factor(NaCl_conc))) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_lnODb), size = I(0.1)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y= fitted), linewidth = I(0.5), se = F, span = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~strain) +
  labs(y = "ln(OD)", x = "t (h)", color = "NaCl, % w/v") +
  theme_bw()
fitted_curves
if(save_graph){
  graph_fn <- file.path(out_folder, str_c("fittedcurves.jpg"))
  ggsave(fitted_curves, filename = graph_fn, dpi = 300)
}

```

## Comparing µ~max~ values

```{r mumaxvalues}
# mumax values
mumaxvalues <- fitted_values |>
  dplyr::filter(term == "mumax") |>
  select(strain, NaCl_conc, best_model, estimate, std.error, p.value)
# print the table
kable(mumaxvalues, digits = 4, caption = "Maximum specific growth rate estimates, 1/h") |>
  kable_classic()

mumax_plot <- mumaxvalues |>
  dplyr::filter(estimate < 1.5) |>
  mutate(sign_factor = factor(case_when(
    p.value <=0.001 ~ "p<=0.001",
    p.value >0.001 & p.value <=0.01 ~  "0.001 < p <=0.01",
    p.value >0.01 & p.value <=0.05 ~ "0.01 < p <=0.05",
    .default = "ns"
  ), levels = c("p<=0.001", "0.001 < p <=0.01", "0.01 < p <=0.05", "ns"))) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = NaCl_conc)) +
  facet_wrap(~strain) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(y = estimate, 
                      ymin = (estimate - std.error), 
                      ymax = (estimate + std.error),
                      shape = sign_factor)) +
  labs(y = "µ<sub>max</sub>, h<sup>-1</sup>",
       x = "NaCl conc. (% w/v)",
       shape = "significance") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown(),
    axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown()
    )
mumax_plot
if(save_graph) ggsave(
  mumax_plot,
  filename = file.path(out_folder, str_c(fn_prefix,"_mumaxplot.jpg"))
)
```

## Fitting a secondary model

Attempts at fitting a non linear secondary model for µ~max~ have filed, most likely because of insufficient data points close to minimum NaCl conc. An attempt at estimating NaCl_max using a modified Ratkowky equation has also resulted in very low goodness of fit.

```{r secondary_model}
# start from the mumax data and nest

mumax_nested <- mumaxvalues |>
  mutate(sqrtmumax = sqrt(estimate),
         aw = 1-0.006*NaCl_conc*10/58.44) |>
  select(strain, NaCl_conc, sqrtmumax, aw) |>
  nest(secdata = c(-strain))
mumax_nested <- mumax_nested |>
  mutate(sec_fits = map(mumax_nested$secdata, \(x) try(nls(formula = cpm_aw_2p, data = x, 
                   start = list(muopt = 0.9, awmin = 0.99))))) |>
  mutate(model_class = map_chr(sec_fits, class)) |>
  dplyr::filter(model_class == "nls") |>
  mutate(tidied = map(sec_fits, tidy),
         glanced = map(sec_fits, glance))

tidied_sec <- unnest(mumax_nested, cols = tidied) |>
  select(strain, term:p.value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, id_cols = strain, values_from = estimate:p.value) |>
  mutate(estimate_NaCl = ((estimate_awmin-1)/-0.006)*5.844,
         std.error_NaCl = ((estimate_awmin-std.error_awmin-1)/-0.006)*5.844-estimate_NaCl)

glanced_sec <- unnest(mumax_nested, cols = glanced) |>
  select(strain, sigma:nobs)

tidied_sec_totable <- tidied_sec |>
  select(strain, est_muopt = estimate_muopt, stderr_muopt = std.error_muopt,
         est_NaClmax = estimate_NaCl, stderr_NaClmax = std.error_NaCl) |>
  left_join(select(glanced_sec, strain, sigma, AIC)) |>
  arrange(strain)

kable(tidied_sec_totable, digits = 2, caption = "Estimates from the secondary model, specific growth rate, 1/h and NaCl conc max. % w/v") |>
  kable_classic()

```
Scondary models were obtained for `r nrow(tidied_sec_totable)` out of `r nrow(mumax_nested)` strains/replicates.
